stem:
Lata asks why day and night follow each other where she lives.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Earth's rotation moves each place into and out of the side facing the Sun.
Earth's rotation keeps every place facing the Sun at all times.
Day and night happen only because Earth revolves around the Sun once each year, not because Earth rotates.
The Sun switches itself off each night and on again each morning.

teacher.key_rationale: Day and night occur because Earth's rotation carries each place into and out of the Sun-facing side.
